subject.why: The object is clearly a stylized conch shell with its signature spiral spire and glossy pink opening.

category.why: It floats freely in the air with a slight tilt on a saturated yellow background featuring centered concentric rings.

clean.why: There are no text, UI elements, watermarks, frames, or characters present.

framing.why: The shell is centrally framed with comfortable margins on all sides and nothing is cut off.

colour.why: Bright, warm, saturated yellow background that provides strong contrast with the cream and pink shell.

detail.why: The surface is clean and smooth with no micro-textures, ridges, or distracting props.

style.why: Matches the reference style perfectly with chunky 3D volumes, soft satin sheen, and no outlines.
